title: Execution claim successor closure
description: Objective: make the existing pure four-leg claimWork result sufficient for a durable activation consumer instead of dropping conserved-budget and slot-dimension facts. Depends on task-c956fd56f0d24e84a33644934982828f. Deliverable: harden claimWork to require the exact server-owned claim command and exact section shapes, pass the slot dimension through the new @moe/scheduler reservation API, and return a frozen typed successor closure containing the active lease, dimension-bound RESERVED provider slot, reservation record, post-reservation BudgetAvailableView, and CLAIMED effect intent. Consumer: task-e33747f982e0452a9f9d784fd1cb914d. NOT in scope: durability, effect arming/activation, attempt creation, recovery embargo, registry wiring, or slot activation. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: A granted claim exposes the typed immutable five-record closure: active lease, dimension-bound RESERVED provider slot, RESERVED budget reservation, shifted post-reservation budget view, and CLAIMED effect intent; tests assert the budget version/bucket delta and slot dimension.

claimWork accepts only the exact outer/section records required by the production command and only `{kind:"claim"}` for the effect leg; alternate commands, accessors, prototype/extra keys, or missing facts refuse before publishing any successor.

A non-claim effect command pins WORK_INTENT_COMMAND_MISMATCH at layer AUTHORITY on leg effectIntent, while existing lease/ceiling/slot/budget/effect refusals retain their exact code, layer, leg, and upstreamCode.
Focused tests assert every refusal has no successor keys, generated hostile cases have a positive case count, and input/result graphs are deeply immutable.

@moe/daemon root retains claimWork and exports the complete updated ClaimSuccessors type closure; the named daemon/scheduler gates pass and mutating the production command or budget-view retention guard reddens its named test.
taskRails: TDD all behavior; every refusal test pins exact code, layer, leg, and upstream code where present.
Do not rerun or reimplement reserveForAdmission in the consumer: retain its actual production post-reservation view in claimWork.
The activation consumer task-e33747f982e0452a9f9d784fd1cb914d must import this production result; fixtures and test-owned authority do not count.
Use only public package roots across boundaries; target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400.

New/changed coverage: POISONS 8->9 (added a transparent proxy that traps nothing), HOSTILE_CASES 48->54, LIVE_CLAIM_CASES 6->9 (transparent proxy table, transparent proxy element, get-trapping element); trapsFire replaced by an asserted `proxy` flag plus `types.isProxy(nodeAt(payload, path))`, so a case must really plant the membrane it names, and probe.hits must now be 0 for EVERY case (a proxy is refused for being one, so no trap may run). implementationPlan.description: Implement the minimum claim composition in work-claim.ts. Exact-snapshot the outer record first, then exact-snapshot each section immediately before its existing leg, accepting only ordinary/null-prototype own-data records with the declared keys and a safe dense own-data liveClaims array; catch/reject proxies and descriptor traps without reading getters. Map structural failures to WORK_PAYLOAD_MALFORMED at the owning leg with AUTHORITY/null while retaining the established lease -> slotCeiling -> providerSlot -> budgetReservation -> effectIntent precedence and all upstream mappings. At the effect leg, distinguish a structurally valid non-'claim' kind as WORK_INTENT_COMMAND_MISMATCH, then invoke applyEffectCommand only with a server-owned {kind:'claim'} literal. Return both reservation and the exact shifted result.view from the single reserveForAdmission call, construct all five typed successors only after every leg succeeds, and rely on the existing deep-freeze boundary without freezing or aliasing caller input. Add concise contract comments only where the fixed-command or second budget output would otherwise be non-obvious; keep this source below 250 lines if practical and never approach 400.
implementationPlan.note: GREEN. Focused: 165/165 pass (was 52 failed | 113 passed). Full daemon typecheck exit 0; full daemon suite 65 files / 1104 tests exit 0 (baseline 1074, +30 new). Fix 1 — categorical proxy refusal: node:util `types.isProxy` (the convention already used at apps/daemon/src/documents/document-work-safe-value.ts) now refuses the outer record, every section, the command and the liveClaims table AND its elements before any trap can answer, so no caller code runs at all. Fix 2 — detachment: sections are now snapshotted DEEP (mirrorDeep), so the graph handed to fenceAuthority/reserveProviderSlot/reserveForAdmission/applyEffectCommand is daemon-owned; the runner can carry the intent's lease binding through and the published, deep-frozen successors still share no object with the caller at any depth. detach() copies only plain/null-prototype own-data records and dense own-data arrays, bounded at depth 24, so a Date/Map/class instance/function/symbol key/hole/non-enumerable field/self-cycle is refused at its owning leg rather than flattened. Leg precedence, all upstream mappings, the server-owned {kind:"claim"} literal and the retained post-reservation view are untouched. Deviation from planningNotes' "keep helpers local": extracted to a new work-claim-shape.ts because the helpers roughly tripled; work-claim.ts drops 250 -> 192 lines and work-claim-shape.ts is 152, both inside the <=250 target instead of one ~300-line file. The new module is runtime tier, so runtime-entrypoint.test.ts's bridge guard required work-claim-shape.js with exact content — added, and that guard passes.

Prove the guards are live by temporarily mutating the production non-claim check and the retained budget-view assignment one at a time, showing the named production-boundary tests red, then reverse each exact edit and confirm the original file hashes are restored (no reset/stash or leftover evidence). Inspect `git status --porcelain`, remove only owned staged entries if necessary, commit only the five explicit owned pathspecs, verify `git show --stat` contains nothing else, and submit for QA; on rejection, reproduce the exact production-surface claim, add a red regression, fix only owned paths, and repeat the final gate/review.
implementationPlan.note: Adversarial review found and fixed a real escape before commit: `Array.isArray` THROWS on a revoked proxy ("Cannot perform 'IsArray' on a proxy that has been revoked"), and mirror asked it before the proxy question with the old try/catch removed — so claimWork raised a TypeError instead of refusing with a stable code (epic rail 4). Red first: added a revoked-proxy poison (5 hostile cases failed with that exact TypeError), a revoked-proxy liveClaims table and a revoked-proxy nested lease binding; then reordered the proxy check ahead of Array.isArray. Matrix now POISONS 10 / HOSTILE_CASES 60 / LIVE_CLAIM_CASES 10 / NESTED_CASES 15, all hand-counted. Five mutation drills, each reddening its NAMED test then reversed by exact reverse-Edit (never git checkout): (1) `exact["kind"] === "claim"` -> `!== undefined` = 7 red incl. "refuses the requestCancel command as a command mismatch"; (2) `view: result.view` -> `view: budget["view"]` = 1 red, "retains the post-reservation budget view, not the caller's input view"; (3) drop types.isProxy from mirror = 20 red proxy cases; (4) claimIntent mirrorDeep -> mirror = 8 red incl. "publishes no object the caller owns, at any depth"; (5) drop the liveClaims element proxy guard = 2 red. All four owned files restored to byte-identical SHA-256 after the drills. Other review findings, all checked: UNSAFE is a private Symbol() (not Symbol.for), so a caller cannot forge it; the module has no mutable state and is concurrency-safe; nothing can throw after the reorder (no getters are invoked, no proxies reach the reflection calls); a proxy nested inside a liveClaims element is unreachable because countOccupyingSlots requires three string fields; a null-prototype input is copied into an ordinary record, which every upstream accepts. Theoretical only: detach is O(payload size), so an enormous payload is copied before the ceiling refuses — bounded upstream at ingress, unchanged from the previous mirrorList behaviour. Post-drill gate all green (daemon typecheck 0, daemon 65/1112, scheduler 42/1219, repo-wide typecheck 0, repo-wide vitest 248 files/5386+1 skipped, verify:foundation 30/487, verify:store 39/444). Correction to my step-5 note: root `pnpm test` covers adapters/packages/tests only — apps/daemon is out of its include list — so the daemon leg is covered by the filtered run, not by the root run; repo-wide typecheck DOES include apps/daemon. Committed 7c464d7 by explicit pathspec, exactly the four owned files (git show --stat shows nothing else); committed bytes hash-match the gated worktree bytes. Scratch .vitest-root.json removed; remaining untracked entries (.moe task json, packages/runner claude-launcher-authority.test.ts) are foreign and untouched.
